summary: End-to-end testing of new Customer Value Lab (CBS04). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed including CRUD (create/list/get/update/soft-delete/trash/restore), auth ownership (student gets 403 on admin study, student list excludes admin studies), AI suggest (functional + money categories return valid Thai suggestions with label/weight 1-3/rationale/principle, invalid category returns 400), AI analysis (returns >50 char markdown, persisted on study), and Nano Banana image generation (~30s end-to-end, returns /api/files/... URL, persisted on brand). Frontend: list page renders, create flow works (debounce save), studio loads with 4 tabs, all data-testids present (cv-list-page, cv-studio-page, cv-tab-*, cv-winner, cv-brand-*, cv-price-*, cv-ai-*, cv-aibox-*, cv-analyze-btn, cv-analysis-md, cv-perception, cv-prof-*, cv-image, cv-img-card-*, cv-gen-img-*), AI strategy renders Thai markdown analysis (~21s), perception SVG renders and profile A/B/C switching works, image tab shows brand cards with generate buttons.
verified_acceptance_criteria: POST /api/cv/studies creates study with 2 default brands (แบรนด์ของเรา + คู่แข่ง A), industry-aware mid-price.
GET /api/cv/studies attaches scores per brand for list cards.
GET /api/cv/studies/{id} returns scores + industry_range; admin can fetch any study (200).
PUT updates brands/title and recomputes scores — verified benefit_total=10.0 when single functional weight=3 set.
DELETE soft-deletes (excluded from list, present in /trash); POST /restore brings back.
Student gets 403 on admin's study GET; student list excludes admin studies.
POST /ai-suggest returns 4-5 Thai suggestions with valid label/weight∈{1,2,3}/rationale/principle for both benefit (functional) and cost (money) categories; invalid category returns 400.
POST /ai-analysis returns markdown (>50 chars), persists ai_analysis on the study document.
POST /generate-image returns image_url (object storage /api/files/...) in ~20-30s; persisted on brand.image_url.
Frontend cv-list-page shows create form, industry chips, submit creates and navigates to /:studyId.
Frontend studio renders 4 tabs (audit/strategy/perception/image) with all expected data-testids.
Audit tab: cv-winner banner present; 2 cv-brand-* cards; cv-price-* fillable; cv-ai-functional triggers /ai-suggest and shows cv-aibox-* with rendered suggestions.
Strategy tab: cv-analyze-btn triggers /ai-analysis and renders cv-analysis-md (verified Thai markdown with 5919 chars).
Perception tab: SVG chart present; cv-prof-A/B/C switchable.
Image tab: cv-img-card-* (2 cards) and cv-gen-img-* (2 buttons) present per brand.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/customer_value.py (~470 lines) — clean factory pattern mirroring conjoint, single responsibility, properly excludes Mongo _id everywhere (find_one with {_id:0} and pop after insert). Good.
AI image gen blocks for ~20-30s synchronously per request — consider streaming/queue if many concurrent users hit this (out-of-scope for MVP).

Score formula caps catScore at 10 (sum of checked weights); this means once 4+ weight=3 factors are checked, additional checked factors are 'invisible'. Document this for users or use sigmoid normalization.

_money_score clamps to [1,10]; for the seed default price = industry mid, money≈5.5 which produces non-zero cost_total even when no factors are checked (creates negative net values on fresh study). This is by design (price is always a cost) but the initial -10.6 winner banner on an empty study may confuse first-time users — consider showing 'ยังไม่มีการประเมิน' until at least one benefit/cost factor is checked.
Pydantic CVStudyUpdate.brands typed as List[Dict[str,Any]] (intentional, lets UI roundtrip the full brand object). Fine but no schema validation — trust client. Acceptable.
Owner check _owns is admin-or-creator, no shared/collaborator concept (matches request).
seed_data_creation: Test studies prefixed TEST_CV_* created by pytest and cleaned up (soft-deleted) after each class. One E2E_CV_* study left in admin's list from the playwright run; not harmful (soft-delete available via UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Value Lab is fully functional. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_customer_value.py and use pytest fixtures (admin_token/student_token via /api/auth/login). Be aware: image-gen test takes ~30s; ai-analysis takes ~21s; ai-suggest ~6-8s. When UI-testing AI strategy, poll cv-analysis-md visibility for up to 60s (not a fixed 20s wait). Backend URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial false-negative on cv-analysis-md was a test-timing issue (waited 20s, actual response 21.5s); confirmed working with polling loop.
